package.metadata: Compact ELF32 header/program table followed by authenticated hash data; split p_offset is not an offset into the MDT file.
package.payloads: PT_LOAD segments with nonzero p_filesz use decimal .bNN indices. BSS is zeroed to p_memsz; gaps are preserved.

boot_sequence: Validate entire package, require its compiled SHA256 pin and authoritative exclusive ownership of both carveouts.
Allocate isolated contiguous uncached PAS metadata; recheck prerequisites after allocation.
Hold fresh interrupt baseline, AOP adsp load state, XO, lcx/lmx, rproc_ddr and crypto_ddr resources.
PAS INIT(1), MEM_SETUP(2), copy/zero/cache-sync, AUTH_AND_RESET(5), first DTB PAS 36 and then ADSP PAS 1.
Require a fresh ready event within 5000 ms and no fatal/watchdog indication.
After clients quiesce, PAS SHUTDOWN(6) for ADSP then DTB, then release metadata and resource references.
failure_handling: Any ambiguous failure after prepare retains metadata/resource references and quarantines the boot epoch. A repeated terminal command cannot clear quarantine.

power_plan.native_selector: First command-DB AUX little-endian u16 entry at or above 384; native array index is the RPMh data value. No literal 384 vote.
power_plan.interconnect_note: These are ICC API bandwidth requests from the pinned remoteproc source, not raw BCM vote encodings. Native provider resolution, aggregation and acknowledgement are still required.

offline_validation: C lifecycle fault injection at every allocation, prepare, PAS, write, sync, ready and shutdown stage under ASan/UBSan.
Python package tests compare generated synthetic and real packages with the independent C parser.
Local stock 56-file package matches the compiled pin and C parser: 56 load segments, DTB span 57344, ADSP span 86507520.
C/C++ power-plan tests check selector conversion, minimum rounding, zero padding, malformed AUX, wrong resource types and lookup failures.
required_native_backends: Boot-epoch reservation/exclusive ownership handoff for both DTB and ADSP carveouts; a UEFI reserved memory descriptor alone is insufficient.
Native shared RPMh resource owner for lcx/lmx/XO and active/wake/sleep aggregation, AOP load-state acknowledgement, rproc_ddr and secure crypto_ddr ICC paths.
Physically contiguous isolated uncached metadata allocation and carveout copy/cache maintenance.
SCM PAS transport with interrupted/busy/waitqueue completion and checked secure result.
Fresh ADSP ready/fatal/watchdog event handling and client quiescence before shutdown.
